sentences.text:
The Hon'Ble Sri Justice N.V.Shravan Kumar
 Writ Petition No.7570 of 2025
Order:

The present writ petition is filed to declare the action of respondent No.2 in not referring the Award No.Nil/2015- 16, file No.B/13/2009-VII-Abadi, dated Nil.02.2016 pertaining to the petitioner property/structure bearing H.No.7-84 situated at Cheerlavancha Village, Sircilla Mandal, Rajanna Sircilla District under Section 64 of Act 30 of 2013 to the LARR Authority, at Hyderabad for enhancement of compensation pursuant to the application dated 25.05.2016 as illegal and arbitrary and consequently direct respondent No.2 to refer the said award for enhancement of compensation.

2. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the Land Acquisition authorities have taken possession of the petitioner's property bearing H.No.7-84 to an extent of 510 sq.yds., of Abadi land without passing an award and without payment of compensation.

It is further submitted that at the time of acquisition, the concerned authorities have not taken measurement of subject house properly and have wrongly estimated and undervalued the dwelling area and structure value.

It is further submitted that the respondent authorities neither at the time of taking measurements nor at the time of taking physical possession issued notice to the petitioner which is in violation of provisions of Land Acquisition Act, 1894.
In that regard, petitioner has made a representation on 25.05.2016 to respondent No.2 i.e., Special Deputy Collector, LA, Rajanna Sircilla District for fixation of fair market value.

entities.text: Special Deputy Collector, LA, Rajanna Sircilla District
entities.label: RESPONDENT

sentences.text: 3. Though various grounds are raised in the writ petition, learned counsel for the petitioner restricts his prayer seeking a direction to respondent authorities to dispose of the petitioner's representation dated 25.05.2016 in a time bound period.

4. Learned Assistant Government Pleader for Land Acquisition appearing on behalf of respondents submits that if the said representation is still pending for consideration, the respondent authorities may be directed to dispose of the petitioner's representation, dated 25.05.2016 and pass appropriate orders in accordance with law.

5. In view of the submission made by the learned counsel on either side and without going into the merits of the case, this writ petition is disposed of directing the respondent authorities to dispose of the petitioner's representation, dated 25.05.2016 and pass appropriate orders strictly in accordance with law, as expeditiously as possible, preferably within a period of eight (08) weeks from the date of receipt of a copy of this order by putting all the concerned parities on notice and give a fair opportunity of hearing to all the concerned parties and communicate the same to the petitioner.
6. With the above observations, writ petition is disposed of, accordingly.
